messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 3101112222 created — high error-rate observed in model warmup pipeline (eu-west-1). PagerDuty PD#INC-9123 paging on-call.

sarah: oncall here. seeing repeated OOMs during model load on pool rwd-gpu-eu-5. Root symptoms: cuda OOMs at load, model deserialization failures, and compile timeouts.

mike: confirm — kubelet on rwd-gpu-eu-5-02 restarted 3x in last 10m. node shows GPU resets in dmesg.

jordan: logs pulled from warmup service attached below. pattern: deserialize fails, immediate cuda alloc fail, then compile waits and times out.

```
[2026-03-15T12:03:41Z] model_warmup: deserialize shard=3 model=rwd-llama-xl-q3 failed: unexpected EOF
[2026-03-15T12:03:42Z] kvcache: gpu_alloc(uid=0,size=12.3GB) -> cudaErrorOutOfMemory
[2026-03-15T12:03:44Z] compile: kernel compile timeout after 120s for op=matmul
```

sarah: first-pass mitigations I'm proposing:
- disable automatic warmup for rwd-llama-xl-q3 (stop concurrent heavy loads)
- flip routing for canary traffic to rwd-llama-large fallback
- drain + reboot affected node(s)
- temporarily disable JIT/compile cache for the model to avoid repeated compile thrash

mike: running drain now on rwd-gpu-eu-5-02, and increasing warmup backoff in config. cmd: `kubectl drain rwd-gpu-eu-5-02 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

jordan: note — disabling compile will increase token CPU/GPU time ~8-12% per request but avoids 2min stalls. good short-term tradeoff.

ashley: CS here — which customers impacted? I see elevated 5xxs for Dedicated tenants in eu-west-1: AcmeCorp and NovaAI have active requests. need ETA and wording for status page.

sarah: current metrics before mitigation: error-rate ~17% for xl-model warmup requests, p95 latency spike to ~12s for ~10% traffic. customers above getting some 504/502s. applying mitigations now.

sarah: applying routing change: `rcli route set-fallback --model rwd-llama-xl-q3 --fallback rwd-llama-large --scope eu-west-1 --immediate`

deploy-bot: Rolling change queued for routing-service (change-id: rc-20260315-7).

mike: node drain completed, rebooted runtime. `systemctl restart redwood-runtime` on rwd-gpu-eu-5-02. reboot logs show NVML GPU reset due to OOM prior to restart.

jordan: patching deployment to set REDWOOD_RUNTIME_DISABLE_COMPILE=1 for warmup pods in canary. will restart 2 canary pods.

deploy-bot: Rolling restart initiated for warmup-canary replicas (rs/warmup-canary-1) — 2 pods restarting.

sarah: canary restarted, monitoring metrics. initial error-rate down to ~6% for routed requests. latency p95 improved to ~3.2s.

kevin: taking over the incident at 12:20Z for 2nd-shift handoff. summary pls and playbook state?

sarah: handoff notes: mitigations applied = routing fallback, node drain+reboot, disabled compile in canary. next steps = roll compile-disable to all warmup pods if stable for 15m, continue draining any nodes with GPU resets, and run a controlled scale-up if traffic continues to hit slow path. customer comm: ashley to send update to AcmeCorp/NovaAI that we mitigated OOM root causes and are monitoring.

ashley: crafting message now. ETA to customers ~10-15m with note: 'mitigation applied, monitoring for residual errors, follow-up once stable'.

kevin: I'll scale warmup replicas down for xl-model to limit concurrent warmups: `kubectl scale deploy/rwd-warmup-xl --replicas=2 -n inference` and keep fallback in place.

jordan: also recommend we increase compile cache TTL and catch exceptions in deserialize to avoid partial shard load attempts. file an infra task for compile-cache tuning.

mike: infra note — suspect a regression in model artifact packaging that created slightly truncated shard files; deserialization EOF seen only on one shard. we're pulling artifacts repo hash to validate. if artifact corrupt -> re-publish fixed shard.

sarah: acknowledged. monitoring shows stabilized traffic and error-rate trending <2%. leaving incident in mitigated -> monitoring. handoff complete to kevin.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 3101112222 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. duration so far 00:10:28. follow-ups: artifact-validation task, compile-cache tuning ticket, and postmortem to be scheduled. :thumbsup:
